verdict.rationale: The axis applies because Nitrokey ships a programmatic surface: the official nitropy CLI (0.13.0) and Python SDK (nitrokey 0.4.2) are versioned packages on PyPI, and firmware has tagged releases (v1.8.3). That shows versioning, but nothing in the evidence documents a deprecation policy, and no OpenAPI or stable API contract was found. missing for 10: documented deprecation policy, explicit API versioning/stability guarantees, changelog or migration guidance, independent corroboration.
